coverage_math.candidate_recall_proxy: 75/101 one-to-one span/target support on exposed diagnostic TRAIN; not qualified semantic recall
coverage_math.denominator_rule: 23 unmatched candidates are hypotheses without alignment to the scoped annotated spans. The annotation packet is not an exhaustive adjudication of every candidate's relevance, and no observed-negative denominator is provided. Therefore 23/98 is not a false-positive rate; 75/98 is not measured precision. Neither is specificity or a confidence interval justified.
coverage_math.family_rule: Matching is one-to-one support accounting. Evaluation/CE weights use canonical source roots and source-owned maximal expressions; parse alternatives, nested projections, aliases and variants are not independent labels or samples.
coverage_math.closure_rule: Holes propagate by required-child union; syntax closes only if each required dependency closes. Maximality, relevance, target, polarity, reference/value resolution and authority remain separate axes.

findings.title: Comma topic and coordinated postposed targets are not preserved
findings.actual: A leading explicit 'For item alpha, use Friday' is cut away; question beta supplies [1]. Postposed alpha and beta returns the first match [0]. The alpha repair governor survives only on Friday in P03; Monday falls back to beta and its correction is unresolved.
findings.required: Parse one source-owned target topic for the local predicate/repair segment, including exact AND coordination before or after the expression. Retain it through a comma only while that predicate/repair continues; an explicit new governor, semicolon/new clause, contrast or incompatible predicate terminates it. Do not borrow the old component target or earlier collective mention. A question fallback cannot override an explicit compatible local governor.
findings.limit: This is a source-scope hypothesis repair, not proof of bank identity, resolved financial targets or permission.

findings.title: Opaque target metadata is typed but not relationally validated
findings.actual: Question target [77] is emitted despite a supplied target universe {0,1}; duplicate label metadata deterministically chooses the first row.
findings.required: Require unique target indexes and question target indexes to be a subset of that universe. Labels that identify multiple target indexes produce unresolved ambiguity, never first-row selection. Incomplete metadata yields target unknown while the date syntax hypothesis may remain available.
findings.limit: No new statistical threshold is involved; these are finite interface invariants.

findings.title: Containment-safe suppression increases overlapping hypotheses
findings.actual: Friday after Monday produces a full relative node and a nested after-Monday top node. Either Friday or produces two open alternatives sharing the same missing second operand. Required holes remain present; the fresh complete/unfinished probes support that mechanical repair.
findings.required: Keep ownership proofs and typed lossless projection. For a grammar-supported equivalent suffix (e.g. the bare alternative inside EITHER), declare a production equivalence only with identical operator/operand/hole semantics. Otherwise record a competing or dependent hypothesis family sharing source evidence; do not treat it as a second independent fact or training unit. Never suppress by interval containment alone.
findings.limit: Overlap is not itself a false positive; an after-Monday bound can be a competing interpretation. No semantic-equivalence claim follows from geometry.

findings.title: Syntax closure does not establish maximal DATE relevance
findings.actual: The unsupported 'earlier of' construction exposes two closed weekday atoms without its comparison. Modal 'May I ask about the recording?' exposes closed calendar May. A dog-name Friday also exposes a closed calendar node with question-scope fallback.
findings.required: Expose unconsumed temporal modifier/dependency evidence and candidate role unknown. A completion target is the maximal source-owned DATE expression, not any closed child. Recognize modal MAY syntactically where supported, without a global word veto. Retain alternate lexical hypotheses if undecidable; mask DATE relevance/maximality separately from local syntactic closure.
findings.limit: These are fresh falsification cases, not new reviewed training truth or a measured deployment false-positive rate.

findings.title: Mechanical feature flags accept truthy strings
findings.actual: privacy_isolated='false' and framing_verified='false' admit 65 features, while boolean False returns none.
findings.required: Require flags to be literal booleans True and carry their independently checked fixture provenance in the offline caller. Reject other types. The flags remain mechanics-only and cannot establish authenticated current user ingress.
findings.limit: All probes retain abstain=True, training_mask=False and qualified=False. This is not an authority leak.

findings.title: Structural feature values are trusted without whole-node source binding
findings.actual: After retaining the valid raw extent/version, a forged kind or operator kind appears in emitted features. Only raw extent and clause bounds are checked by this function.
findings.required: Keep parse plus feature extraction behind one pure source-owned API, or verify a canonical node against re-parsing the exact source/context/parser version. Validate closed enums, exact operator/marker extents, child edges and event binding before accepting an externally supplied node. A local source/context digest detects mixing, but does not authenticate customer ingress.
findings.limit: The current diagnostic constructs nodes internally. The mutation probes test an exposed-function precondition, not evidence that the internal pipeline consumed annotations or that a deployed authority was bypassed.

findings.title: Finite local windows alias opposite polarity
findings.actual: The distant 'Do not schedule' and 'Please schedule' pair produces identical 137-feature vectors; the 48-character left window excludes the differentiating governor. The node polarity is unassessed in both.
findings.required: Associate head-specific source dependencies with each candidate. DATE completion can remain complete in both; polarity and proposal-role heads need an admissible scoped-governor feature or an unknown/masked output when that dependency is outside the window. Increasing model size cannot separate equal vectors.
findings.limit: This does not show DATE completion is wrong. No negation-driven whole-turn blanking is warranted.

minimal_learning_contract.inference: Small sparse linear binary heads + calibrated decoder, standard-library CPU JSON bundle; no external inference or bank tool additions. Head scores are not joint probabilities or permissions.
minimal_learning_contract.failure_objective: Known unsupported/missing/ambiguous source dependencies mask only the affected axes. No candidate detection does not establish absence. New atoms do not manufacture label support. Any source-authority failure retains whole proposal shadow status.
minimal_learning_contract.lower_bound: If two semantically different polarity/role inputs map to identical features as F06, every deterministic classifier on those features must assign the same score; representation correction or per-axis abstention is necessary.
minimal_learning_contract.support_math: Keep the existing floor rather than introduce another gate: n_y is unique eligible canonical roots after complete ancestry unions, source/profile/privacy/candidate masks. Full support 20 can become 16 in balanced 5-fold training. Report each fold's actual support, not total nominations. Current new support is 0; old V5 27/19 and 20/16 do not satisfy both class floors.
minimal_learning_contract.no_new_auth: An unchanged schema, fixture transport flag, semantic agreement or source digest cannot issue parent fit authorization or authenticated current runtime ingress.

source_stage: For the same frozen TRAIN source, report per-root candidate-family counts, supported one-to-one maximal span/target alignments, visible holes and local target relations before/after; adjudicate unmatched candidate relevance on TRAIN with two independent reviewers plus closure rather than label it false by non-match

Report candidate-level role/maximality/target eligibility masks and canonical root counts after feature extraction and ancestry unions, including rejects; no reviewed old DEV or V9 TRAIN promotion to qualification
learning_stage: Only after real support closure and source/parent fit authorization, freeze exact features and root folds before fitting

Compare source-only parser rule baseline, phase-only, text-only, full scoped context and root-label permutation control with identical eligible folds and losses; omit a fold if its actual per-class train support fails the existing floor
Mask-weighted group/turn/candidate-mean BCE and group-level OOF loss/error/coverage; retain disagreements and failure-to-abstention counts. OOF-selected thresholds are exploratory, not qualification
Publish native/serialized model-feature parity, complete bundle bytes and cold/load/per-turn CPU time on identical bounded inputs; sparse feature parity alone is not learned accuracy
minimum_actual_benefit_evidence.calibration_and_qualification: Separate new canonical-root calibration-fit and risk samples only after data/features/model freeze; final qualification is later blind, independent and unexposed. Machine annotations are not human/IID bank-groundtruth. Exact one-sided binomial bounds require defensible independent-group sampling and frozen selection; no current risk estimate is asserted.
minimum_actual_benefit_evidence.GPU: No demonstrated CPU model/feature bottleneck, new trained weights or qualified coverage exists here. GPU use cannot resolve target binding, feature aliasing, unknown ancestry or lack of ingress. A future frozen encoder comparison needs actual CPU-controlled improvement plus audited adapter/parent reservation; current spend remains 0.
